description: Implementation of the ShippingService interface in the shopizer core, providing methods for retrieving and saving shipping configurations, calculating shipping quotes, handling supported countries, and managing shipping modules.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation providing core business logic for shipping operations, configurations, quotes, and module management.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration for a given merchant store, parsing stored JSON data.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific shipping module configuration based on module code for a store.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates the shipping configuration for a store.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom shipping module configuration for a store.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Fetches available shipping modules applicable to a store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves shipping module configuration.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping module configuration from the store.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns currently configured shipping modules for a store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary of shipping costs and options based on selected quote and option.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates available shipping quotes for a delivery, considering configuration, products, and existing modules.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns list of supported countries for shipping based on configuration.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Provides list of countries eligible for shipping to for a store, based on configuration.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Updates list of supported countries for shipping for a specific store.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the cart items require shipping based on the products.
